summary: Configured node1 to present an Ed25519 host certificate signed by a locally generated SSH host CA. A strict client successfully connected through the managed IP using only an @cert-authority trust entry. Configuration and connectivity survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Generated a protected Ed25519 host CA under /etc/ssh/host_ca.
Signed the existing Ed25519 host key for principals node1 and 10.100.160.10.
Configured and validated OpenSSH HostCertificate loading.
Verified an authenticated SSH session with strict checking and no pinned host key.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot ID changed.
Reverified sshd, certificate files, CA-only trust, and SSH connectivity after restart.

evidence.summary: Shows the CA fingerprint and root-owned permissions: 0700 directory, 0600 private key, and 0644 public key.

evidence.requirement: Host certificate signed by the authority
evidence.summary: Shows an Ed25519 host certificate signed by the created CA, including validity and node1/IP principals.
Shows valid sshd configuration, effective HostCertificate directive, successful reload, and active port 22 listeners.

evidence.requirement: Client connects by trusting the CA without pinning the host key
evidence.summary: The trust database contains only an @cert-authority entry; strict SSH negotiated ED25519-CERT, matched the CA, and completed an authenticated session.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, then recovered sshd service, persisted CA/certificate/configuration, active listener, and successful post-restart CA-only SSH connection.
